name: JBLM
description: Army-Air Force joint base; McChord Field hosts 62nd Airlift Wing C-17 operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Visitors without a DoD ID must obtain a pass at a Visitor Control Center or be processed at the Main Gate when VCC is closed.

gates.name: McChord Field Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 McChord Field access via I-5 Exit 125 (Bridgeport Way). Visitor Control Center located adjacent to Main Gate. Call 253-982-2119 for visitor pass coordination.
gates.address: I-5 Exit 125, Bridgeport Way, McChord Field, WA 98438

gates.name: McChord Field Visitor Control Center
gates.notes: Visitor passes and DBIDS registration. Located outside McChord Main Gate off I-5 Exit 125. After-hours visitors processed at Main Gate guard shack.
gates.address: Bldg 849, Bridgeport Way, McChord Field, WA 98438

gates.name: McChord Field Barnes Gate
gates.notes: Secondary McChord Field access via Perimeter Road, approximately ½ mile from Lincoln Boulevard Gate exit of Lewis Main.

gates.name: McChord Field Commercial Gate
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle and contractor access on McChord Field. Closed weekends and federal holidays.

gates.name: Lewis Main Liberty Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 Lewis Main access via I-5 Exit 120. Lewis Main Visitor Control Center (0500-2200 daily) located outside Liberty Gate. Joint base context for Army-side medical, housing, and services.
gates.address: I-5 Exit 120, Lewis Main, Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA 98433

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Services Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HSO before signing any off-base lease. McChord Inn offers temporary lodging on McChord Field — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: McChord Main Gate is open 24/7 via I-5 Exit 125. Barnes Gate is daily 0500-2000. Commercial Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-1700. Visitor Control Center hours are daily 0600-1930. Lewis Main Liberty Gate is 24/7 for joint base access. REAL ID required for all visitors.
